digest.component_or_area: Rich-text codec infrastructure + state-based echo suppression
propositions: A state-based echo-suppression mechanism using persisted 8-byte rich_sha + change-gated rich_reemit counter must replace round-trip idempotence gates, with a single post-push GET at threshold 2 overlaid via merge_baseline.

Cloud and DC send paths must compose codec operations (to_wire, fit_outbound, normalize_outbound) consistently across create and update routes, with an explicit flag-gated cutover defaulting OFF and degrading to plain-text when markdown libraries are absent.

Baseline compares must normalize only the local side through normalize_outbound while emit compares use decoded remote, ensuring lossy round-trips cancel without forcing legacy re-emits on Jira-authored constructs.
Concurrent both-sides edits must keep rebar's version (local-wins), raise an outbound-field-conflict alert, and record the remote value without adding new merge logic or LWW clocks.

The WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound redefinition must not reach the comment-diff dedup key (routed via _IdentityCodec), preserving converged comments across the flag flip and preventing mass re-posts.
